name: Why do drywall cracks frequently reappear in Denver and Aurora homes?

mainEntity.name: Why do drywall cracks frequently reappear in Denver and Aurora homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver, Aurora, and nearby front-range communities, seasonal shifts between dry winter indoor heating and summer humidity cause wall framing to expand and contract. This movement often produces recurring hairline cracks above doorframes, window corners, and vaulted ceiling joints. A quality repair addresses this by scraping back old compound, using flexible fiberglass mesh or paper tape embedded in setting-type compound, and securing any loose framing nails or screws before finishing, preventing the crack from reopening during seasonal climate shifts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Seasonal humidity shifts and framing movement in Colorado homes cause stress cracks around doors and windows. Proper taping and setting compound are required to keep cracks from reopening.
